$comment: Bhutan Luxe deployment: the CRM and the entities it requires, nothing else.
(Team Portal), portal (Client Portal), campaigns, retreats, boards, htt, library.
ideas and client-programs are here only because crm requires org, org requires ideas,
and crm requires client-programs. They are not in the nav.
company-os owns the admin login, home and error pages, so it is required in practice.
campaigns (Revenue > Marketing) is installed. It requires site, and its overview reads library;
both are `unmounted`: their code is present but none of their routes, APIs or crons are mounted.
skipCrons keeps only campaigns/email-campaign-send scheduled; the content agents stay off.
